sentences.en: Nowadays, we use different products for personal cleanliness, laundry, dishwashing and household cleaning, but this is very much a 20th-century development
sentences.zh: 如今，我们使用各种产品来满足个人清洁、洗衣、洗碗和家庭清洁的需求，但这种做法很大程度上是20世纪才发展起来的。

sentences.en: The origins of cleanliness date back to prehistoric times
sentences.zh: 清洁的起源可追溯至史前时代。

sentences.en: Since water is essential for life, the earliest people lived near water and knew something about its cleansing properties - at least that it rinsed mud off their hands
sentences.zh: 由于水是生命所必需的，最早的人类居住在水源附近，并且对水的清洁特性有所了解——至少知道它能冲掉手上的泥巴。

sentences.en: During the excavation of ancient Babylon, evidence was found that soapmaking was known as early as 2800 BC
sentences.zh: 在古代巴比伦遗址的发掘过程中，发现了早在公元前2800年人们就已掌握制皂技术的证据。

sentences.en: Archaeologists discovered cylinders made of clay, with inscriptions on them saying that fats were boiled with ashes
sentences.zh: 考古学家发现了由黏土制成的圆筒，上面刻有铭文，说明当时将动物脂肪与草木灰一同煮沸。

sentences.en: This is a method of making soap, though there's no reference to the purpose of this material
sentences.zh: 这是一种制皂方法，尽管铭文中并未提及该物质的具体用途。

sentences.en: The early Greeks bathed for aesthetic reasons and apparently didn't use soap
sentences.zh: 早期的希腊人出于审美目的沐浴，显然并未使用肥皂。

sentences.en: Instead, they cleaned their bodies with blocks of sand, pumice and ashes, then anointed themselves with oil, and scraped off the oil and dirt with a metal instrument known as a strigil
sentences.zh: 他们用沙块、浮石和草木灰擦拭身体，然后在身上涂抹油，再用一种名为刮身板（strigil）的金属工具刮去油污和污垢。

sentences.en: They also used oil mixed with ashes
sentences.zh: 他们还曾将油与草木灰混合使用。

sentences.en: Clothes were washed without soap in streams
sentences.zh: 衣物则在溪流中不用肥皂清洗。

sentences.en: The ancient Germans and Gauls are also credited with discovering how to make a substance called 'soap', made of melted animal fat and ashes
sentences.zh: 古代日耳曼人和高卢人也被认为发现了如何用熔化的动物脂肪与草木灰制成一种名为‘肥皂’的物质。

sentences.en: They used this mixture to tint their hair red
sentences.zh: 他们用这种混合物将头发染成红色。

sentences.en: Soap got its name, according to an ancient Roman legend, from Mount Sapo, where animals were sacrificed, leaving deposits of animal fat
sentences.zh: 据古罗马传说，肥皂（soap）一词源自萨波山（Mount Sapo），那里曾举行动物祭祀，留下大量动物脂肪。

sentences.en: Rain washed these deposits, along with wood ashes, down into the clay soil along the River Tiber
sentences.zh: 雨水将这些脂肪连同木灰一起冲刷下来，汇入台伯河沿岸的黏土土壤中。

sentences.en: Women found that this mixture greatly reduced the effort required to wash their clothes
sentences.zh: 妇女们发现，这种混合物能极大减轻洗衣所需的体力劳动。

sentences.en: As Roman civilisation advanced, so did bathing
sentences.zh: 随着罗马文明的发展，沐浴文化也随之进步。

sentences.en: The first of the famous Roman baths, supplied with water from their aqueducts, was built around 312 BC
sentences.zh: 第一座著名的罗马浴场约建于公元前312年，由引水渠供水。

sentences.en: The baths were luxurious, and bathing became very popular
sentences.zh: 这些浴场极为奢华，沐浴也变得极为流行。

sentences.en: And by the second century AD, the Greek physician Galen recommended soap for both medicinal and cleansing purposes
sentences.zh: 到了公元二世纪，希腊医生盖伦（Galen）已推荐将肥皂用于医疗及清洁目的。

sentences.en: After the fall of Rome in 467 AD and the resulting decline in bathing habits, much of Europe felt the impact of filth on public health
sentences.zh: 公元467年罗马帝国灭亡后，沐浴习惯随之衰落，欧洲大部分地区因此深受公共卫生领域污秽问题的影响。

sentences.en: This lack of personal cleanliness and related unsanitary living conditions were major factors in the outbreaks of disease in the Middle Ages, and especially the Black Death of the 14th century
sentences.zh: 这种个人清洁缺失及相关不卫生的生活条件，成为中世纪疾病暴发的重要因素，尤其是14世纪的黑死病。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, soapmaking became an established craft in Europe, and associations of soapmakers guarded their trade secrets closely
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，制皂业在欧洲已成为一门成熟的手艺，制皂师行会严密守护着各自的工艺秘密。

sentences.en: Vegetable and animal oils were used with ashes of plants, along with perfume, apparently for the first time
sentences.zh: 植物油和动物油开始与植物灰烬及香料混合使用，这似乎是首次出现。

sentences.en: Gradually more varieties of soap became available for shaving and shampooing, as well as bathing and laundering
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，出现了更多种类的肥皂，适用于剃须、洗发，以及沐浴和洗衣。

sentences.en: A major step toward large-scale commercial soapmaking occurred in 1791, when a French chemist, Nicholas Leblanc, patented a process for turning salt into soda ash, or sodium carbonate
sentences.zh: 1791年，法国化学家尼古拉·勒布朗（Nicholas Leblanc）获得了一项专利工艺，可将食盐转化为纯碱（即碳酸钠），这是大规模商业化制皂迈出的关键一步。

sentences.en: Soda ash is the alkali obtained from ashes that combines with fat to form soap
sentences.zh: 纯碱是从草木灰中提取的碱性物质，能与脂肪反应生成肥皂。

sentences.en: The Leblanc process yielded quantities of good-quality, inexpensive soda ash
sentences.zh: 勒布朗法可大量生产优质且廉价的纯碱。

sentences.en: Modern soapmaking was born some 20 years later, in the early 19th century, with the discovery by Michel Eugène Chevreul, another French chemist, of the chemical nature and relationship of fats, glycerine and fatty acids
sentences.zh: 现代制皂业诞生于约二十年后，即19世纪初；另一位法国化学家米歇尔·欧仁·谢弗勒尔（Michel Eugène Chevreul）发现了脂肪、甘油与脂肪酸之间的化学本质及相互关系。

sentences.en: His studies established the basis for both fat and soap chemistry, and soapmaking became a science
sentences.zh: 他的研究奠定了脂肪化学与肥皂化学的基础，使制皂成为一门科学。

sentences.en: Further developments during the 19th century made it easier and cheaper to manufacture soap
sentences.zh: 19世纪期间的进一步发展，使肥皂的制造变得更简便、更便宜。

sentences.en: Until the 19th century, soap was regarded as a luxury item, and was heavily taxed in several countries
sentences.zh: ：在19世纪之前，肥皂被视为奢侈品，在多个国家被课以重税。

sentences.en: As it became more readily available, it became an everyday necessity, a development that was reinforced when the high tax was removed
sentences.zh: 随着肥皂供应日益充足，它逐渐成为日常必需品；而高额税收的取消进一步强化了这一发展趋势。

sentences.en: Soap was then something ordinary people could afford, and cleanliness standards improved
sentences.zh: 此后，普通民众也能负担得起肥皂，整体清洁标准随之提高。

sentences.en: With this widespread use came the development of milder soaps for bathing and soaps for use in the washing machines that were available to consumers by the turn of the 20th century
sentences.zh: 随着肥皂的广泛使用，出现了专为沐浴设计的温和型肥皂，以及适用于20世纪初已进入消费者家庭的洗衣机的专用肥皂。
